svg.aria-label: DEBATE: Five roles on one Claude model. The moderator frames, proposer and critic argue, the judge rules. Max 3 rounds by default. RESEARCH: Proposer and critic search the live web with Tavily, up to 4 tool calls per turn. Sources appear as inline links. TRACE: Every call goes to LangSmith and Langfuse at the same time. Same run, two UIs. Tool errors stay visible
